Its GIS & Digital Solutions specialists apply GIS and environmental data to client projects, including WebGIS portals and dashboards.

notes: No confirmed WSP E&IS office in München. WSP's German office list shows a Munich office (Design Offices Munich Arnulfpark, Luise-Ullrich-Straße 20, 80636) without naming the entity; beruf.wsp.com/locations/muenchen lists only building/project-management jobs (likely WSP Deutschland GmbH), and the E&IS GIS ads name Nürnberg, Frankfurt (WSP E&IS), Isernhagen and Nordhorn. Impressum: WSP E&IS GmbH, Weserstraße 4, 60329 Frankfurt, HRB 48580. g_stack from 'GIS Specialist' and 'Senior Consultant GIS & Digital Solutions' ads (German C1, English B2). Size: ads say ~200 employees in Germany at 8 locations (WSP group >84,000). li_url is the global WSP page (seen as ca.linkedin.com/company/wsp); no German company page found. kununu given by owner.

eng: intermetric is a surveying and engineering-measurement company headquartered in Stuttgart with eight offices in Germany, including Munich. It provides building, track, tunnel, industrial and plant surveying, geomonitoring (own system iGM.NET) and network documentation for construction and industry clients. Surveying data, 3D laser scanning and digital terrain models are its core product.

Es bietet Hochbau-, Gleis-, Tunnel-, Industrie- und Anlagenvermessung, Geomonitoring (eigenes System iGM.NET) und Netzdokumentation für Bau und Industrie. Vermessungsdaten, 3D-Laserscanning und digitale Geländemodelle sind das Kernprodukt.
notes: München address (Hofmannstraße 52, 81379 München) from intermetric.de/kontakt. Current München ad: Werkstudent Vermessung (AutoCAD, MicroStation, 3D laser scanning, DGM); C#/C++/PHP/JS/MS-SQL/MariaDB from Stuttgart SW-developer ad. Size from homepage 'über hundert Vermessungsexperten' (exact count not given). eng: Schüßler-Plan is an independent engineering group headquartered in Düsseldorf with over 1,200 employees and more than 20 offices in Germany plus Warsaw. It plans transport infrastructure, structures and buildings and offers BIM, environmental planning and surveying. Surveying (site surveys, staking out, construction monitoring, digital terrain models) supports its planning projects.
de: Schüßler-Plan ist eine unabhängige Ingenieurgruppe mit Sitz in Düsseldorf, über 1.200 Mitarbeitenden und mehr als 20 Standorten in Deutschland sowie Warschau. Sie plant Verkehrsinfrastruktur, Ingenieurbauwerke und Hochbau und bietet BIM, Umweltplanung und Vermessung an. Vermessung (Bestandsaufnahmen, Absteckung, baubegleitende Überwachung, digitale Geländemodelle) unterstützt die Planungsprojekte.
notes: Potsdam address from schuessler-plan.de/en/contact.html; the Potsdam office is run by Schüßler-Plan Ingenieurgesellschaft mbH (Schüßler-Plan GmbH is the Düsseldorf holding) - kept c_name as given to match existing records. No GIS-specific job ads found (job portal is JS-rendered); DGM from the surveying service page, Revit/CARD/1 named in the company profile (academy training). sprach from career page note that job listings are German-only. LinkedIn URL linked from their location-portraits page.

eng: CGI is a global IT and business consulting company; its German entity has 26 offices, including Düsseldorf. As a long-standing Esri partner it advises on and implements GIS solutions for energy and utilities, industry, defence and government clients. Its space business (Darmstadt and Bochum) builds ground-segment and Earth-observation data platforms.
de: CGI ist ein weltweit tätiges IT- und Beratungsunternehmen; die deutsche Gesellschaft hat 26 Standorte, darunter Düsseldorf. Als langjähriger Esri-Partner berät CGI zu GIS und setzt GIS-Lösungen für Energieversorger, Industrie, Verteidigung und Verwaltung um. Das Raumfahrtgeschäft (Darmstadt und Bochum) entwickelt Bodensegment- und Erdbeobachtungs-Datenplattformen.
notes: Used the official legal name (title of cgi.com/de/impressum) instead of 'CGI Deutschland – Space': the Düsseldorf office (Heesenstraße 31, 40549, from cgi.com/de/de/Lokationen) is a general CGI office; no evidence the space team works there (space jobs list Darmstadt and Bochum). GIS evidence = Esri partner listing (no specific ArcGIS products named). kp_url seen in search results but page could not be fetched. li_url is the global CGI page. Size from 'CGI 5001 or more' listing. sprach unverified (space ads require English).

eng: DLR is Germany's national research centre for aeronautics, space, energy, transport, digitalisation and security, headquartered in Cologne-Porz. The Cologne site has about 1,850 staff, nine institutes, the Executive Board and central administration. The Cologne-based Institute of Solar Research works on solar energy meteorology, measuring and predicting solar irradiation.
de: Das DLR ist das nationale Forschungszentrum Deutschlands für Luftfahrt, Raumfahrt, Energie, Verkehr, Digitalisierung und Sicherheit mit Hauptsitz in Köln-Porz. Am Standort Köln arbeiten rund 1.850 Beschäftigte in neun Instituten, dazu Vorstand und zentrale Verwaltung. Das Kölner Institut für Solarforschung arbeitet zur Solarenergiemeteorologie und misst und prognostiziert die Sonneneinstrahlung.
notes: Address 'Linder Höhe, 51147 Köln' (no house number) from dlr.de Köln site pages. Institutes in Köln confirmed by name: Institut für Frontier Materials auf der Erde und im Weltraum, Institut für Solarforschung (solar energy meteorology, irradiation measurement/prediction). Found no Köln-based GIS/remote-sensing job ad; Earth-observation units (EOC/DFD) were not shown to be in Köln, so the GIS/remote-sensing link of this site is weak. g_stack and sprach left null. li_url from dlr.de/en/dlr footer.
